title: Helwit Mint Nicotine Pouches 7mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Mint Nicotine Pouches offer a fresh take on a classic flavour profile. With its cool, crisp taste and clear menthol character, this pouch delivers a straightforward Mint experience that’s bright, balanced and consistently refreshing. Each pouch is slim, discreet and made using plant-based materials, designed to sit comfortably under the lip and release nicotine steadily over time. The 7mg strength delivers a moderate, balanced experience with no smoke, vapour or odour. Whether you’re new to nicotine pouches or simply prefer familiar flavours, Helwit Mint is a clean and convenient option that fits easily into your daily routine. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
